name: New York

statute.readVia: web.archive.org snapshot 2026-10-12 of the official page

windshield.strip: material with less than 70% light transmittance allowed only in the uppermost 6 in. of the windshield

frontSide.note: side wings/side windows forward of or adjacent to the operator's seat

backSide.note: applies to station wagons, sedans, hardtops, coupes, hatchbacks and convertibles

rear.note: rear window may be below 70% if side mirrors on both sides give a clear and full view of the road behind

backSide.note: the 70% rear-side rule is limited to station wagons, sedans, hardtops, coupes, hatchbacks and convertibles; SUVs, vans and trucks are not listed

rear.note: with side mirrors on both sides

tint.measuredHow: not stated ('composed of, covered by or treated with any material which has a light transmittance of less than seventy percent')
tint.dualMirrors: Side mirrors on both sides required for a rear window below 70%
tint.certificateOrSticker: Medical exemption: DMV sticker attached to each shielded window. A window tested by DMV and found compliant receives a small conformity label (375(12-a)(d)).

medicalExemption.text: DMV Commissioner exemption (windshield and front side windows) for a person needing shielding from the sun who drives or is habitually transported; physician's or nurse practitioner's statement with the condition and minimum light transmission; condition must be on the Health Commissioner's list; sticker affixed

penalty.text: Traffic infraction; general penalty (VTL 1800): up to $150 and/or 15 days for a first conviction, higher on repeat within 18 months

quotes: the front windshield of which is composed of, covered by or treated with any material which has a light transmittance of less than seventy percent unless such materials are limited to the uppermost six inches of the windshield

the sidewings or side windows of which on either side forward of or adjacent to the operator's seat are composed of, covered by or treated with any material which has a light transmittance of less than seventy percent
if it is classified as a station wagon, sedan, hardtop, coupe, hatchback or convertible and any rear side window has a light transmittance of less than seventy percent
A rear window may have a light transmittance of less than seventy percent if the vehicle is equipped with side mirrors on both sides

helmet.conditions: All motorcycle operators and passengers (FMVSS 218 helmet)

handheldPhone.fineText: Handheld call: $50-$200 first violation; higher caps for repeat violations within 18 months (up to $450 read in the text); texting/portable device use governed by § 1225-d

studdedTires.season: Oct 16 - Apr 30 (prohibited May 1 - Oct 15 inclusive, except school buses and state/municipal vehicles; stud size limits)

radarDetector.note: No ban for passenger vehicles found; commercial vehicles over 18,000 lb are restricted under VTL 397-a (not read); also banned federally over 10,001 lb (49 CFR 392.71)
